types.description: Registry anchor for the attributes every lifecycle move shares (ADR-0054): not authorable.

children.name: permission
children.description: As on an operation: the permission name the derived command for this transition asks the policy about. Absent and not @public: the derived name `<package>.<transition>`. Read only when the transition derives its own command; a declared operation that claims it uses its own.

children.name: public
children.description: As on an operation: the derived command calls no permission check. Declaring it with @permission is ERR_PERMISSION_PUBLIC_CONFLICT.

types.description: An allowed move between two values of a `field.enum`, made by an operation (ADR-0063). A `field.enum` with at least one is a lifecycle, named after the field. Its states are the enum's @values, its initial state the enum's @default, its terminal states the members no transition leaves; none of them has vocabulary of its own. Each transition becomes a guarded update (`... WHERE id = ? AND <field> IN (@from) [AND @condition]`), its own command when no declared operation claims it, its own permission point and its own wire error.
types.whenToUse: A status field whose values may only change in certain ways: a request is submitted from draft, approved or rejected from submitted. Declare each allowed move here, and the generic update path can no longer write the field. A move that leaves the state where it was (from submitted to submitted) records an action that changes nothing but still happened, such as a first approval of two.
types.rules: Legal only under a `field.enum` of an `object.entity` that has a writable source, or of an abstract entity whose concrete inheritors have one (ERR_TRANSITION_NOT_ON_ENTITY). The field must declare @default (ERR_LIFECYCLE_NO_INITIAL). Names are unique across every lifecycle of the entity and may not be create, get, list, update or delete (ERR_TRANSITION_NAME_COLLISION).

children.name: from
children.description: The states this move may start from: members of the parent enum's @values (ERR_TRANSITION_UNKNOWN_STATE otherwise). The allowed moves are the business rule itself, so they cannot be computed.

children.name: to
children.description: The state this move ends in: one member of the parent enum's @values (ERR_TRANSITION_UNKNOWN_STATE otherwise). May equal a member of @from, which records an action that leaves the state where it was.

children.name: condition
children.description: A guard over the entity's own fields, in the attr.expression grammar: the same name, grammar and meaning as on the cross-field validators. Evaluated against the loaded row and also put into the guarded update's WHERE. It cannot read the actor; that is the policy's job. A field the entity does not have, or an expression that is not boolean, is ERR_BAD_ATTR_VALUE.
